subject: Request: split SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough — evening/after-hours windows?
messages:
From: Emily Johnson <emily@finsecure.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@finsecure.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: split SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough — evening/after-hours windows?

Hi Soojin / Irene,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 + DPA review here at FinSecure and would like to run two short walkthroughs: one focused on SOC 2 controls (45–60 min) and a separate DPA evidence handoff / data flow chat (~30 min). A lot of our reviewers are east-coast PMs and SREs who are only available in the evening after 7pm ET (UTC-4).

Would Redwood be able to offer an after-hours window next week (Tue–Thu after 7pm ET) or a single split-session where we do SOC 2 first and DPA immediately after? If possible, please indicate what the recommended cadence is for your side (back-to-back vs separate days).

We also have an internal artifact list prepared — attaching our intake template so you can see what we've mapped.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Johnson
Head of Compliance, FinSecure Labs
[Attachment: evidence-request-template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Johnson <emily@finsecure.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: split SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough — evening/after-hours windows?

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the template, this is helpful.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can accommodate after-hours slots. For efficiency, we recommend one back-to-back session on the same day (SOC 2 deep-dive then DPA handoff) if your reviewers can stay for ~90 minutes total. If you prefer separate audiences / reviewers, we can split them across two 60/30 windows on consecutive days.

Proposed windows (all times ET):
- Tue 14 Jun, 7:30pm–9:00pm ET (back-to-back)
- Wed 15 Jun, 8:00pm–9:00pm ET (SOC 2) + Thu 16 Jun, 7:00pm–7:30pm ET (DPA)

Irene, Markus — can you confirm team availability for those windows? I can open a provisional calendar hold and share a Zoom link; we have a short pre-call checklist (attendees, objectives, artifacts) — I'll attach Redwood's one-pager so reviewers know who to expect.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-security-ops-one-pager.pdf (pdf)]

From: Emily Johnson <emily@finsecure.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: split SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough — evening/after-hours windows?

Thanks, Soojin — that sounds good. Our compliance reviewers prefer the back-to-back single-night approach (keeps context). Can you confirm expected attendee list from Redwood for the SOC 2 portion (engineering lead + product security)? We'll bring 3 reviewers and one legal observer.

If the Tue 14 Jun 7:30pm–9:00pm ET slot is still open, please hold it for us while we confirm internally. Also: can you confirm whether you record the session and if you share the recording and the bridge transcript after? (We typically archive recordings for audit evidence.)

Emily
Emily Johnson
Head of Compliance, FinSecure Labs

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Emily Johnson <emily@finsecure.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 12:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: split SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough — evening/after-hours windows?

Thanks — I can cover the SOC 2 controls walkthrough (architecture & controls owner) and Iris will do the DPA/dataflow piece. Both of us are available Tue 14 Jun 7:30pm ET for the back-to-back session — I can block the calendar.

Notes for scheduling:
- Recommend 90 minutes total: 55m SOC 2 (control mapping + Q&A), 25m DPA (data flows + evidence handoff), 10m buffer.
- We'll record the session and export the Zoom transcript; we store recordings in our compliance bucket and can share a link for your archive.
- Please upload any artifacts to the Drive link you included (or we can accept a short SFTP exchange if preferred).

Soojin — please create the hold and include a short pre-read (agenda + expected attendees). Emily — if you confirm, we'll convert the hold to a formal invite and include dial-in details.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

All right — we confirm Tue 14 Jun 7:30pm–9:00pm ET for the back-to-back session. Attendees:
- FinSecure: Emily Johnson (lead), Ravi Patel (SRE), Kara Mendes (Product), Alice Huang (Legal observer)
- Redwood: Markus Klein (controls), Iris/ I. Choi (dataflow), Soojin Lee (solutions lead)

We're uploading the key artifacts to the Drive link now. Please send the calendar invite and Zoom link and we'll accept. Also appreciate if you can mark the event as recorded in the invite.

Thanks — looking forward.
Emily
